svg.title: Two writers, three readers: find every reader before a private mode
svg.text: Before a private mode, list every reader and its uid.
root can read; writes two places
the host user, outside the containers
their own uids: a umask would close this
so: the private mode is a setting (PQCH_VAR_PRIVATE=1), turned on where every writer and reader is one uid;
a process-wide umask is not used, because the second file is read by other uids by design
